<reason>CON won a competitive debate by keeping the motion’s “enough” bar tied to night trust, shared-inventory costs, and identity/fallback ops, while PRO overclaimed that nobody else is slowed, then retreated to “seconds” and definitional arithmetic. PRO’s matched-ride harm story stayed live, but it never fully answered cream-skimming, thin-supply failure, or complexity, and two clipped rebuttals plus a premature “no name came” shot weakened the close.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON’s Q2/A2 exchange forced PRO to admit leftover-inventory inefficiency, then showed “seconds” is a dense-daytime story that collapses at 11 p.m.—the hour PRO used to sell the feature.</best_rebuttal>
